rules.rule: The same sign-aspect effects apply to the Moon in the several Dwadasamsas; hora/drekkana-lord aspects give benefic effects
For the Sun the same readings apply with Solar and Lunar aspect exchanged; the rising Navamsa follows the Moon's rules

notes: Rows = the Moon's sign; columns = the aspecting planet. v1 Aries-Cancer, v2 Leo-Scorpio, v3 Sagittarius-Pisces. Clauses naming several planets at once ('if by Saturn, the Sun or Mars') are shared (merged_with).
